name: Fixed-rate Block-coding (VTC/S3TC)
definition: Hardware-supported fixed-rate block-coding techniques that approximate voxel values by selecting linear interpolation modes from a lookup table and applying a formula over precomputed representative values.
summary: Fixed-rate Block-coding (VTC/S3TC) is a hardware-supported lossy compression method that enables real-time volume rendering directly from compressed data without storing decompressed volumes in memory.
